issue.title: Generate an RSS feed for the blog section
issue.author: lina-w
issue.body: I'd like mdsite to write a feed.xml for pages under content/blog, newest first, using the title, date and summary from front matter. Right now I generate it with a separate script after every build. A `feed: true` option in mdsite.config.yml would be enough for me.
